narrator
text: Kanpur Shatabdi. Six hours late. Meet *Bablu*: 21, B.Tech third year, four backlogs (exams to retake), one suitcase.

speaker: new_kid
text: Gurugram internship letter! Stipend: ₹8,000. Accommodation: *"figure it out"*.

speaker: narrator
text: Agla station: *New Delhi*. Population: yes. Air quality: also yes.

speaker: new_kid
text: Plan: a flat in *Noida*. Cheaper rent, only two hours from the office. But every society gate says *NO BACHELORS*.

speaker: narrator
text: No bachelor rents without *police verification*, stamped at the *Sarkari Daftar* (the government office). The internship starts in *11 days*.

speaker: new_kid
text: One flat. One stamp. 11 days. How hard can it be?

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: A *bachelor*? At MY gate? I am Pinky. RWA WhatsApp admin. I wrote that board myself.

speaker: new_kid
text: Aunty, I am just an engineering student. I need a room for my internship—

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: *Engineer?!* Beta, my WiFi is not working since Diwali. Also the TV says "No Signal". Also my phone is full.

speaker: new_kid
text: (turns it off and on again)

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: WAH. Genius. Okay, I will help you. You are like my son. Who is in Canada. And never calls.

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: But first, forward this to 10 people. Sharma ji didn't forward, and now his flat has *seepage*.

speaker: narrator
text: *Rajiv Chowk* metro. 6 PM. Bablu has a flat viewing at 6:30.

speaker: new_kid
text: Excuse me, my stop is next, can I just—

speaker: jaanu
text: *Bro.* Can't you see we're having a *moment*?

speaker: shona
text: Babe, he's staring. Babe. *BABE.* Do something.

speaker: narrator
text: The doors are blocked. The viewing is in 30 minutes. There is only one way out.

speaker: daaru_uncle
text: *Hic.* Beta. You look lost. Everyone in Gurugram is lost. That is the business model.

speaker: new_kid
text: Uncle, do you know where Cyber Hub is?

speaker: daaru_uncle
text: Know it? I *sleep* in it. Come. I will protect you. I have bottles.

speaker: narrator
text: A street dog follows Bablu out of the metro. Bablu gives him half a samosa.

speaker: sheru
text: *Bhow.*

speaker: new_kid
text: Okay. You can come. Your name is Sheru now.

speaker: rival_student
text: Bablu? From *that* college? I'm Kush. Tier-1. I'm also here for police verification.

speaker: new_kid
text: Want to team up?

speaker: rival_student
text: Sure. I'll share my notes. You do the fighting. I'll put it on my LinkedIn.

speaker: rwa_aunty
text: Beta. The RWA has voted. 47 to 1. The 1 was you.

speaker: new_kid
text: Aunty! I fixed your WiFi!

speaker: rwa_aunty
text: And now it works, so I don't need you. Rules are rules. *No bachelors.*

speaker: rwa_aunty
text: And for disrespecting the society notice board... *the head will be shaved.*

speaker: narrator
text: *Amma's Nursing Home*. The ceiling fan is doing its best. So is Amma.

speaker: sadhu
text: Beta, you were dead for four minutes. I have seen worse. Drink this.

speaker: new_kid
text: What is in it?

speaker: sadhu
text: *Jadi-booti.* Ashwagandha, triphala, and a little bit of the Yamuna.

speaker: narrator
text: Bablu feels strong. Bablu feels green. Bablu feels like going back to *yesterday*.

speaker: broker
text: Sir! Sir! Welcome welcome. Very nice flat, sir. East-facing. Vastu-compliant. Metro walking distance.

speaker: new_kid
text: The metro is 4 km away.

speaker: broker
text: No problem, sir! Walking distance. For a fit person.

speaker: broker
text: One month brokerage. One month deposit. One month "documentation". One month "my cousin's wedding".

speaker: new_kid
text: That's four months! I get ₹8,000 a month!

speaker: broker
text: Sir, the owner is *very nice*. Very nice. I am not.

speaker: broker
text: Okay okay! Sir, half brokerage. Final. Okay, quarter. Okay, I'll throw in a free... *temporary address proof*.

speaker: new_kid
text: Is it valid?

speaker: broker
text: Valid for 11 months, sir. Like everything.

speaker: ceo
text: Bablu! My new intern! Welcome to *Lalaji & Sons Pvt. Ltd.* We are a *startup*. Since 1972.

speaker: new_kid
text: Sir, about the stipend—

speaker: ceo
text: Stipend? Beta, this is a *family business*. You are family now. Family does not get paid.

speaker: ceo
text: First task: our *culture-fit round*. And if you win, I call the *board*. The board is my relatives.

speaker: ceo
text: Okay okay! Board meeting adjourned. Bunty, write in the bahi-khata: *intern passed*.

speaker: new_kid
text: So do I get paid now?

speaker: ceo
text: Beta, it is an *unpaid* internship. But you can work from your flat. You do have a flat, right?

speaker: babu
text: Hmm.

speaker: new_kid
text: Sir, *police verification*. For a rent agreement. Just one stamp.

speaker: babu
text: Bachelor?

speaker: new_kid
text: ...Yes.

speaker: babu
text: Bachelor verification is a different window. *Window 7*. Window 7 is closed since 2009.

speaker: babu
text: Let us begin the procedure. Original, three photocopies, self-attested, attested by gazetted officer... and your *soul*.

speaker: babu
text: ...Fine. Stamped. Now go.

speaker: new_kid
text: *POLICE VERIFICATION: VALID FOR 11 MONTHS*. Pinky Aunty! I got it!

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Beta, wonderful! But the RWA had an emergency meeting. New rule: *no bachelors under 30*.

speaker: new_kid
text: I am 21.

speaker: narrator
text: Your phone buzzes. *Delivery Wale Bhaiya*: "Sir, 2 minute."

speaker: new_kid
text: ...I love this city.

speaker: narrator
text: Everything is temporary. Except Delhi.
